resource: Due timed-revert records one scope revert-driver wake admits
allocation_impact: A wake fires at most this many due records in (deadline, scheduling ordinal, sequence) order and then returns to the scope owner; the remainder is neither dropped nor fired in the same wake and is reported as still due for a later wake.
boundary_tests: configured batch B (tested at B=1): B due records fire in one wake
B+1: the next due record stays PENDING and the wake reports more_due; a later wake fires it
a configured batch above 32 is refused when the driver limits are built
consumers: apps/game-server/src/world_object_revert.rs (ScopeRevertDriver::wake; not yet wired into a live Channel or Instance owner)
notes: Section 7 bounded due-work admission (FND-03 sections 7 and 14), same shape as MovementOwnerTurn's bounded max_inputs. Registered by OTV2-20260928-cw1-timed-revert-runtime (issue #162): a lane policy value, not a measurement.
